ideas.pitch: An AI-powered sentiment and crowd-consensus intelligence platform that aggregates forecasting data from Glimpse to auto-generate trading signals and strategy insights for Bitcoin and altcoins.
ideas.title: GlimpseCrowdPulse
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly leverages Glimpse's core dataset (what thousands of people believe will happen next), fulfilling the exact mission of building a product using real-world forecasting and market data.

ideas.pitch: A funding rate and prediction arbitrage dashboard that compares perpetual futures funding rates across DEXs with crowdsourced price expectations from Glimpse forecasting markets.
ideas.title: SatoshiSqueeze
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines advanced trading mechanics with Glimpse's crowd sentiment data, appealing to judges looking for deep quantitative market utilities.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI agent framework that uses free starting sats to automatically participate in Glimpse forecasting rounds based on on-chain momentum indicators and sentiment analysis.
ideas.title: AgentForecaster
ideas.why_it_could_win: Taps into the growing agentic workflow trend by automating participation in Bitcoin forecasting markets using the platform's initial sat allocations.

ideas.pitch: A social copy-forecasting platform allowing retail users to mirror the exact Bitcoin and asset price predictions of top-performing forecasters on Glimpse using their sat balances.
ideas.title: GlimpseMirror
ideas.why_it_could_win: Brings viral social trading dynamics directly to forecasting markets, making it an engaging product demonstration for judges evaluating portfolio-ready apps.

ideas.pitch: A micro-hedging tool that utilizes Glimpse prediction market outcomes to automatically lock in Bitcoin value against downside volatility using short-term price targets.
ideas.title: HedgeSats
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves real risk-management problems for holders of Bitcoin and sats, aligning with the Bitcoin-focused ethos of the hackathon organizers.
